mentions.name: Per-project workspaces for niri (Linux)
mentions.description: This Linux workspace setup for the niri window manager keeps the author's projects separate in their own workspaces, similar in spirit to Drawers. The author also sees per-worktree separation as an emerging additional level, where each git worktree of a project gets its own IDE and browser when multiple AI agents run in parallel.
mentions.problem: To keep the author's projects separate.
mentions.source_excerpt: But I work on something similar for niri on linux. Trying to keep my projects separate.
